Integrate Spring Data JPA with a relational database (e.g., H2 or PostgreSQL) for stream persistence to leverage metadata and ensure failure recovery.
Leverage Spring Cloud Stream for Spark Streaming integration in streaming pipelines to align with latest XD and Spark specifications.

Receptor API is well-documented and stable, allowing for straightforward client creation without extensive API reverse-engineering.
Effort estimates assume a single full-time developer with proficiency in Java, Spring Framework, and related technologies.
Documentation tasks involve standard technical writing with minimal research, based on clear requirements from user stories.
No external dependencies or delays are anticipated, and estimates focus purely on development effort.
